about.title: Your Strategic Partner in the Energy Supply Chain
about.desc: AL_DAIRAH is a leading national company specialized in transporting and supplying petroleum products (Diesel & Gasoline). We bridge Saudi Aramco bulk plants with fuel stations, factories, and mega-projects via an advanced, GPS-monitored fleet.
about.visionText: To be the premier and most trusted petroleum transport and energy logistics partner across Saudi Arabia.
about.missionText: Delivering safe, punctual, and sustainable fuel transport solutions through certified drivers and modern fleet technology.
about.goalText: Achieving maximum schedule reliability with zero operational incidents across all industrial zones.
